summary: Every Post-Processor Property now declares a Property Scope (machine, job, run, internal) that decides whether the Machine Editor or the Post-Processing Dialog may edit it; the dialog's Options tab now actually renders Job-scope properties, LinuxCNC blend_mode/blend_tolerance reappear in the Machine Editor, and show_dialog moves from the Machine Editor to the dialog's Overview tab.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Gui/DlgPostProcess.py: _rebuild_post_config_section() is now called, so the Options tab gains a 'Postprocessor Properties' group listing job-scoped properties (tool_change, blend_mode, blend_tolerance, plasma delays); Overview tab now reads the full schema so the common show_dialog property appears there

Machine/ui/editor/machine_editor.py: updatePostProcessorProperties() filters on SCOPE_MACHINE/SCOPE_JOB, so blend_mode/blend_tolerance return to the editor and show_dialog (now SCOPE_RUN) leaves it; DlgPostProcess.py Options tab now provides the per-export override of job-scoped values
Machine/ui/editor/machine_editor.py: editor now shows machine- and job-scoped properties only; show_dialog disappears from the Postprocessor tab, LinuxCNC blend properties appear

Path/Post/Processor.py: schema entries gain a 'scope' key (SCOPE_MACHINE/JOB/RUN/INTERNAL, default job, 'runtime': True kept as alias for run); new property_scope() and properties_in_scope() helpers; every common property now tagged

Path/Post/Processor.py and scripts/linuxcnc_post.py, generic_plasma_post.py, opensbp_post.py: machine-based posts declare 'scope' per property instead of the 'runtime' boolean; linuxcnc blend properties become job, opensbp hardware switches become machine

Path/Post/Gui/DlgPostProcess.py: same dialog is used; its Options tab now shows a Postprocessor Properties group, so any dialog screenshot is stale but the page's description of the command is unchanged
Roadmap/ADR/ADR-000.md: glossary additions (Post-Processing Dialog, Post-Processor Property, Property Scope) are contributor vocabulary; the roadmap page only points at the ADR directory

meta.title: CAM: Give postprocessor properties an explicit editing scope
